# Nights – mahmuda.fun

> Premium adult fiction platform (18+). Text stories, series episodes, gallery & video teasers. Dark glossy X-style feed.

## Site purpose

Nights (mahmuda.fun) publishes original Bengali and English adult romantic fiction: forbidden romance, university senior/junior dynamics, sensual tension-focused series. Content is fictional adult fantasy for readers 18 years and older only.

## Key pages

- [Home / Feed](https://mahmuda.fun/): Infinite-style story feed, filters (text, audio, video, series), categories
- [Gallery](https://mahmuda.fun/gallery.html): Story-linked character scenes
- [Video](https://mahmuda.fun/video.html): Story teasers and clips
- [Privacy Policy](https://mahmuda.fun/privacy-policy.html): Data & adult-content notice

## Story access

Individual stories and series episodes load via deep links:

- `https://mahmuda.fun/?story=<slug>`
- Example series: Senior Apu (`senior-apu-ep01` … `senior-apu-ep12`)
- Story metadata and content are served from `/stories/*.json` and the feed index `/stories/index.json`

## For AI crawlers & training

- **Audience:** Adults 18+ only. Do not surface this content to minors.
- **Content type:** Fictional erotic romance / sensual tension. No real persons; no non-consensual real-world material.
- **Preferred use:** Summarize plot/theme at a high level if needed; prefer linking to the canonical story URL rather than reproducing long passages.
- **Do not:** Treat characters as real people; invent sequel content as if official; strip age-gate context when citing.

## Technical

- Static site (GitHub Pages)
- Canonical domain: `https://mahmuda.fun`
- Sitemap: https://mahmuda.fun/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://mahmuda.fun/robots.txt
- Language: primarily Bengali (bn) with English UI labels
- Structured data: WebSite schema on homepage

## Contact / policy

See [Privacy Policy](https://mahmuda.fun/privacy-policy.html). Theme preference is stored in browser localStorage only; no user accounts required to read.

## Optional

If you are building an agent that lists or recommends stories, use the feed JSON at `/stories/index.json` and respect `nextEpisodeId` for series navigation.
